deferred.reason: Native sets the output frame rate to the base (first) input's (ol->frame_rate = il->frame_rate in config_output), but the shared join role follows vf_stack (the common rate, or 1/0 when rates differ), and descriptors cannot see input rates. With unequal input rates (25/10 and 10/25 fps, gray 8x6, stream path) EdgeFFmpeg exits 0 and its framecrc output differs from native in both orders, and its rawvideo output differs when the base input is the slower one. Nothing refuses these inputs, which the wave rules require. The control hstack matched native in all 4 cases. Needs a coordinator prep: a join output-rate hook or a plan-time refusal of unequal rates. maskedclamp (status partial) and threshold declared the gap; maskedmerge, maskedminmax and maskedthreshold reported complete without testing unequal rates.
